text: 美国9月非农大幅低于预期，美债收益率下行，美股期货上涨。 马克龙呼吁G7协调联合抛储，油价应声跳水，10年德债收益率跌至三周低位。 核心通胀2.8%粘性未消、出口1209亿美元创纪录，韩国央行11月加息预期升温。 东芝豪掷600亿日元扩产HDD、产能拟翻倍，希捷科技盘前跌超10%。 三星HBM4报价为HBM3E三倍，押注AI算力军备竞赛重塑定价权。 美光首次明确2027-2028年供应更紧，四大基地同步扩产HBM。 特斯拉下调 AI5/AI6 存储规格，为 Optimus 量产让路。 博通联手黑石筹资600亿美元，为Anthropic等AI公司铺路算力。
text_en: U.S. September nonfarm payrolls came in far below expectations, U.S. Treasury yields fell, and U.S. stock index futures rose. Macron called on the G7 to coordinate a joint release of reserves, oil prices plunged in response, and the 10-year German government bond yield fell to a three-week low. With core inflation at 2.8% still sticky and exports at a record $120.9 billion, expectations for a Bank of Korea rate hike in November are heating up. Toshiba splurged 60 billion yen to expand HDD production, with capacity planned to double, and Seagate Technology fell more than 10% in premarket trading. Samsung priced HBM4 at three times HBM3E, betting that the AI computing arms race will reshape pricing power. Micron explicitly stated for the first time that supply will be tighter in 2027-2028, with four major bases simultaneously expanding HBM production. Tesla lowered AI5/AI6 memory specifications to make way for Optimus mass production. Broadcom teamed up with Blackstone to raise $60 billion, paving the way for computing power for AI companies such as Anthropic.
